Name: SGs 'Mirren The Florist' a Retextured Sprite
Author: SilverGoldsun
Description:
Hello [b]Awkward Geckos[/b]!

I love the florist, Mirren, but was not pleased with how different he looked when compared to other npc characters while using Poltergeister's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]. I wanted him to have a wider build/ [b]no bowlegs[/b], and pronounce his amazing streak of blonde hair to match his portrait.

With permission from the mod author, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/70364918]Specialagentjonson[/url], I've uploaded my retextured sprites to replace the originals!


This mod [b][u]requires[/u] [/b]you to have installed [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39733?tab=description]Mirren The Florist[/url], it will do absolutely nothing on its own and just sit there like a pet rock.





[center][size=4]Instillation Instructions:[/size][/center]


[list=1]
[*][b][color=#1e84cc]Manually [/color][/b]download my mod file[/*]
[*]Under your downloads, right click on the zipped folder and hit [b][color=#1e84cc]extract all[/color][/b][/*]
[*]Open the mod folder and you will find Mirren's retextured seasonal sprites[/*]
[*][b][color=#1e84cc]Copy [/color]and [color=#1e84cc]paste[/color][/b] all retextured sprite sheets into the original mod folder: [CP] Mirren The Florist > assets > images > longhair[s]/or/[/s]ponytail[/*]
[*][b][color=#1e84cc]Replace [/color][/b]the original files in the folder with my mods[/*]
[/list]

This is my first ever mod, so please be gentle with my fragile soul. I would love any feedback, and to hear from you guys! Depending on what you Geckos think, I may see about posting other sprites I've redone for my own gameplay.

IMPORTANT NOTE! I've updated Mirren's body composition for both files. However, I have yet to playtest with it through all seasons and events. Please let me know if there are any issues.


Until then, stay sassy!

- SGs
